```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
require(yaml)
```

```{r setup}
library(rqcr)
#drugRegister('path/to/file', 'drug-register-configuration.yaml')
```

The `drug-register-configuration.yaml` looks like this:
```yaml
identifiers:
  individual: IID
  dispensation_date: dateDelivery
  dispensation_days: DDD
rename:
  oldName: newName
```
